questions.question: What is the value of 1² + 2² + 3² + ……… + 14²?
How many times the digit 7 appears in the number from 1 to 90?
questions.solution:
From 1 to 69, number of times ‘7’ appears is = 7

From 70 to 80, number of times ‘7’ appears = 11 (2 times in 77)

From 81 to 90, number of times ‘7’ appears = 1

∴ Total number of times digit ‘7’ appears = 7 + 11 + 1 = 19

questions.question: What is the value of sqrt{1500+sqrt{441}} ?
If 373P is divisible by 4, then what is the value of P?
questions.solution:
A number will be divisible by 4 if the last two digits of the number are divisible by 4.

If P = 2

The number consisting of last two digits = 32, which is divisible by 4

∴ The number will be 3732 and will be divisible by 4.

If P = 6

The number consisting of last two digits = 36, which is divisible by 4

∴ The number will be 3736 and will be divisible by 4.

∴ The value of P is 2 or 6.

questions.question: Which of the following is not a perfect square?
questions.solution:
**Concept used:**

N = {a₁}{ⁿ_¹} times {a₂}{ⁿ_²} times {a₃}{ⁿ_³} times ldots times {a_n}{ⁿ_ⁿ}; {a₁,}{a₂},{a₃} are prime numberand {n₁},{n₂},{n₃} are even

Then N is a perfect square. Otherwise not

**Calculation:**

1024 = 2¹⁰

1521 = 3² × 13²

1444 = 2² × 19²

876 = 2² × 3 × 73

All prime factors of all numbers have even power except 876.

**∴ 876 is not a perfect square.**

questions.question: A, B and C together can complete a work in 15 days. B and C can complete the same work in 20 days. In how many days A alone can complete the same work?
questions.solution:
A, B and C together can complete a work in 15 days

Part of work A,B and C can complete in 1 day = 1/15

B and C can complete the same work in 20 days

Part of work B and C can complete in 1 day = 1/20

∴ Part of work A alone can do in 1 day = 1/15 – 1/20 = 1/60

∴ A alone can do the work in 60 days

questions.question: P, Q and R together can complete a work in 20 days. P alone can complete the work in 40 days, Q alone in 60 days then in how many days R alone can complete the work?
questions.solution:
P, Q and R together can complete a work in 20 days

Part of work P,Q and R can complete in 1 day = 1/20

P can complete the same work in 40 days

Part of work P can complete in 1 day = 1/40

Q can complete the same work in 60 days

Part of work Q can complete in 1 day = 1/60

∴ Part of work R alone can do in 1 day = 1/20 – 1/40 – 1/60 = 1/120

∴ R alone can do the work in 120 days

questions.question: What is the area of a rhombus having one side as 30 cm and one diagonal as 36 cm?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Side of the rhombus = 30 cm

One diagonal = 36 cm

**Formula used:**

Area of Rhombus = (Product of length of two diagonals)/2

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b0e7f57e4a7e67f5ea6042fdf32a8b05e9100be897bbd3bda06566bd91afd2f2.png] 

Let,

One side, AB = 30 cm

Diagonal, AC = 36 cm

∵ Diagonals of rhombus bisects each other perpendicularly.

∴ AO = CO = AC/2 = 18 cm

And,

BO = DO = BD/2

From right angled triangle ∆AOB, Using Pythagoras theorem

AB² = AO² + BO²

⇒ 30² = 18² + BO²

⇒ BO² = 900 – 324

⇒ BO² = 576

⇒ BO = 24 cm

∴ BD = 2 × BO = (2 × 24) cm = 48 cm

∴ Area of the rhombus

= (36 × 48)/2

= 36 × 24

= 864 cm²

**∴ The area of the rhombus is 864 cm².**

questions.solution:

Selling price = Rs. 5400

Cost price = Rs. 5200

Discount = 10%

∴ Marked price × 0.90 = Selling Price

⇒ Marked price × 0.90 = 5400

⇒ Marked price = 5400/0.90

⇒ Marked price = 6000

∴ Marked up price

= Marked price – cost price

= Rs. 6000 – Rs. 5200

= Rs. 800

∴ Percentage mark-up = [Marked-price – cost-price)/cost-price] × 100

= [(6000 – 5200)/5200] × 100 =

= 15.38%

questions.question: Cost price of an article is Rs. 3600. It was sold at a proﬁt of 15%. If the article was sold at a discount of 8%, then what is the marked price (in Rs.) of the article?
questions.solution:
Given,

Cost price = Rs. 3600

Profit percentage = 15%

∴ Selling price = Rs. (3600 × 1.15) = Rs. 4140

Discount = 8%

∴ Marked price × 0.92 = Selling Price

⇒ Marked price × 0.92 = 4140

⇒ Marked price = 4140/0.92

⇒ Marked price = 4500

questions.question: 200 litres of alcohol solution has 30% alcohol in it. How much alcohol should be added to make it 50% in the solution?
questions.solution: Amount of solution = 200 litre Percentage of alcohol = 30% ∴ Amount of alcohol in the solution = (0.30 × 200) litre = 60 litre Amount of the other component of the solution = (200 – 60) litre = 140 litre ∴ Amount of alcohol should be added to make it 50% in the solution = (140 – 60) litre = 80 litre

questions.question: In a college, the ratio of boys and girls is 5 : 3 and the ratio of girls and teachers is 7 : 1. What is the ratio of students and teachers?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Combine the ratios by equalising the common term (Girls) using cross multiplication.

Boys : Girls = 5 : 3 and Girls : Teachers = 7 : 1

Combined Ratio (Boys : Girls : Teachers) = (5 × 7) : (3 × 7) : (3 × 1) = 35 : 21 : 3

Total Students = Boys + Girls = 35 + 21 = 56 parts

Ratio of Students to Teachers = 56 : 3

**∴ The correct answer is 56 : 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Ratio of Boys to Girls (B : G) = 5 : 3

Ratio of Girls to Teachers (G : T) = 7 : 1

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2f2d6d7b0953c3d51716ff3733b74eb9ecc6610f184135b25ce4d24592da5e95.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ To find the continuous ratio B : G : T, we make the ratio value of Girls equal in both given cases.

⇒ The LCM of 3 and 7 is 21.

⇒ Multiply the first ratio B : G by 7 to get (5 × 7) : (3 × 7) = 35 : 21

⇒ Multiply the second ratio G : T by 3 to get (7 × 3) : (1 × 3) = 21 : 3

⇒ Now the continuous proportion is B : G : T = 35 : 21 : 3

⇒ Total number of students = Boys + Girls

⇒ Total students = 35 + 21 = 56 units

⇒ Number of teachers = 3 units

⇒ Required Ratio = Total Students : Teachers

⇒ Ratio = 56 : 3

**∴ The correct answer is 56 : 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Continuous Proportion

If two ratios a : b and b : c are given, the combined proportion a : b : c can be determined directly by equalising the common term 'b' using the LCM method.

Compound Ratio

When two or more distinct ratios are multiplied with each other, the resulting fraction is called a compound ratio. For a : b and c : d, the compound ratio is ac : bd.

Invertendo Rule

If an equality exists between two ratios such that a : b = c : d, then by the invertendo property, their inverses are also equal: b : a = d : c.

questions.question: What is the average of ﬁrst 9 odd numbers?
questions.solution:
We know that,

Sum of first n odd number = n²

∴ Sum of first 9 odd number = 9² = 81

∴ Average of ﬁrst 9 odd numbers= 81/9 = 9

questions.question: A man buys 8 oranges for a rupee and sell 6 oranges for a rupee. What is the proﬁt percentage?
questions.solution:

Cost price of 1 orange = Rs. (1/8)

∴ Cost price of 6 oranges = Rs. (6/8) = Rs. (3/4)

Given,

Selling price of 6 oranges = Rs. 1

∴ Profit percentage= [(selling price – cost price)/cost price] × 100

= [(1 – ¾)/(3/4)] × 100

= 33.33%

Govind covers 3/11 of the total distance by train and the remaining 72 km by bus. What is his total journey (in km)?
questions.solution:
Let,

The total journey is = x km

He covers 3/11 of the total distance by train

∴ Distance covered by train = 3x/11

∴ Remaining distance = x - 3x/11

= 8x/11

Given,

The remaining distance = 72 km

∴ 8x/11 = 72

⇒ 8x = 11 × 72

⇒ x = 11 × 9

⇒ x = 99 km

questions.question: A man can row 10 km/hr in still water. If the speed of the current is 2 km/hr, he takes 3 hours more upstream than downstream. What is the distance (in km)?
questions.solution:
Speed of the man in still water = 10 km/h

Speed of the current = 2 km/h

Speed of the man along the current = (10 + 2) km/h = 12 km/h

Speed of the man against the current = (10 – 2) km/h = 8 km/h

Given,

He takes 3 hours more in upstream than in the downstream

Let, The distance is x km = x/8 – x/12 = 3

⇒ x = 72 km

questions.question: A certain sum becomes 'k' times in 6 years at compound interest. In 24 years it will become how many times?
questions.solution:
We know the formula for compound interest –

CI = [P{1 + r/100}t – 1]

Where,

CI = Compound interest

P = Principal

R = Rate of interest

T = Time period

According to the question,

⇒ kP – P = [P {1 + r/100}⁶ – 1]

⇒ kP = P {1 + r/100}⁶ ----- (1)

∴ Total sum becomes after 24 year

⇒ P {1 + r/100}²⁴ = P [{1 + r/100}⁶]⁴

Using equation (1)

= Pk⁴

questions.question: If the expenditure in year Y2 is Rs. 40000, then what is the revenue (in Rs) in that year?
questions.solution:
From the chart

Profit percentage in Y2 = 25%

Expenditure = Rs. 40000

Profit percentage = [(Revenue – Expenditure)/Expenditure] × 100

25 = [(Revenue – 40000)/40000] × 100

⇒ Revenue – 40000 = 25 × 400

⇒ Revenue = 10000 + 40000

⇒ Revenue = 50000

questions.question: If the revenue in year Y5 is Rs. 96000, then what is the expenditure (in Rs.) in that year?
questions.solution:
From the chart

Profit percentage in Y5 = 20%

Revenue = Rs. 96000

Profit percentage = [(Revenue – Expenditure)/Expenditure] × 100

20 = [(96000 - Expenditure)/Expenditure] × 100

0.20 × Expenditure = 96000 – Expenditure

⇒ 1.20 × Expenditure = 96000

⇒ Expenditure = 96000/1.20 = 80000
